text:
infra-audit-bot: Alert: detected new IRSA mapping in prod cluster 'redwood-prod' -> sa:analytics mapped to arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodWideAccess. Detected 2026-03-20T15:03:19Z. Observed API calls: s3:ListBucket, kms:Decrypt (failed). Risk: HIGH.

samir: On it. Which change created this mapping?

elaine: I saw a helm rollout earlier this morning for monitoring. Might be the values override. Checking PRs.

josh: That was my merge — hotfix for sidecar RBAC. I accidentally set `values.oidc.annotation` to the wide role while trying to debug metrics. Rolling back now.

samir: Stop the rollout if possible. Options: patch the SA annotation or revert helm release. `kubectl -n analytics patch sa analytics -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"iam.amazonaws.com/role":null}}}'`

devsecops: Containment checklist (immediate): 1) revoke OIDC trust on the IAM role; 2) remove SA annotation in k8s; 3) lock down any S3 buckets the role touched; 4) rotate creds if any long-lived keys. I'll take step 1 now. @josh @samir

infra-audit-bot: Action log: revoked sts:AssumeRole for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodWideAccess at 2026-03-20T15:07:02Z.

maria: Looked at S3 access: bucket `app-logs-prod` had ListBucket at 15:05Z by that role, no GetObject. KMS: 2 Decrypt attempts but both failed due to restrictive key policy. No data exfil signs so far.

samir: Good. Next steps: 1) set `app-logs-prod` ACL to private & block public access; 2) run CloudTrail lookup for AssumeRole cross-account events; 3) rotate role keys; 4) add alert for new IRSA mappings.

josh: Pushed rollback PR to infra: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4221 — will update helm values to `iam.amazonaws.com/role: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodReadOnlyRole` and re-deploy.

elaine: Applying patch now: `kubectl -n analytics apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: analytics
  annotations: {}
EOF`

devsecops: Created incident SEC-2026-134 (Sev2) in Jira, notifying CISO and Legal. Channel #sec-incident-134 created. Enabling KMS key rotation and increasing CloudTrail retention for 90 days.

ciso-bot: Acknowledged. Please produce timeline and suspected blast radius in the ticket.

samir: Follow-ups: add an IaC guardrail to block templating `values.oidc.annotation` without explicit approval, add a pre-merge IaC check for IRSA annotations, and create a runbook for IRSA drift.

maria: Quick infra check: no new node groups, security groups unchanged, no unusual outbound connections from cluster. Network exposure looks contained.

josh: Sorry for the accidental override — will scan other charts for similar overrides and lock those values.

infra-audit-bot: Summary: OIDC mapping removed, role trust revoked, helm override rolled back, S3 ACL set to private, incident ticket created. Recommend 24–72h heightened monitoring and a postmortem to land mitigations (guardrails + pre-merge checks).

samir: Agreed. Assigning postmortem leads: elaine + devsecops. Will pick timeline and publish notes after initial containment. :thumbsup:
